reasons: The selector uses otel_metric_type="gauge", but system.network.io is a sum in the dataset (dataset_types: [sum]). The matcher would select no series, so the translation returns nothing.

Changing the matcher to otel_metric_type="sum" would make the selector correct. The system_network_direction="transmit" filter is a reasonable mapping of bytes_sent, since the Datadog metric counts only sent bytes, and the label name matches the observed dataset label.

rate() over $__rate_interval is acceptable on this monotonic sum and matches the 'per sec' widget title. The Datadog query itself has no rate function, so the rate step should be confirmed against the intended quantity.
